measurement.observationUnit: One published ACS five-year household income median estimate per state-equivalent geography.
measurement.targetPopulation: Households represented by the Census 2020-2024 five-year ACS B19013 median income estimator for 50 states, DC and Puerto Rico.

caveats: The year field marks the 2024 ACS five-year release; observations pool 2020-2024 responses, not single-year 2024 measures.
Publisher B19013_M001 is a 90% margin of error. It is not a standard deviation or a recomputed interval; do not add or subtract it to generate an unreviewed interval product.
State household medians are not additive, and a histogram across jurisdictions is not a household-weighted or person-level distribution.
Source has 52 state-equivalent records including Puerto Rico; unavailable observations, if present in future vintages, require paired null estimate/MOE.
